brief: How to price consulting work — 5 frameworks that get you paid.

slots.title: Price Based on Client Value
slots.body: Stop tracking hours. Price based on the business outcome your client receives. When they win big, you earn more without penalty for efficiency.

slots.title: Productize Your Core Service
slots.body: Bundle your process into a fixed-scope deliverable with a set price. Clients love clarity, and you escape the hourly trap forever.

slots.title: Lock In Monthly Retainers
slots.body: Charge a monthly fee for ongoing access to your expertise. It smooths cash flow and builds long-term client relationships.

slots.title: Offer Good Better Best Tiers
slots.body: Offer three options. Most buyers pick the middle tier, while the anchor makes your preferred price feel like a smart choice.

slots.title: Reverse Engineer Your Income Goal
slots.body: Decide your annual income and work backwards to project fees. This ensures every engagement pushes you toward your real target.

slots.title: Collect Deposits Before You Start
slots.body: Require a deposit before work begins. It filters serious clients and protects your time from scope creep or late payments.

slots.headline: Price with confidence
slots.body: Ready to stop undercharging and start scaling? Book a free strategy call today.
